title: Premium Payments, Delinquency and Termination for Nonpayment under the TRICARE Premium-Based Plans
content:
These are the payment terms of the **TRICARE Premium-Based Plans**.

## Paying premiums

- The initial payment may be made by any of the tier's initial-payment methods; every later monthly premium must be paid through one of the tier's recurring payment methods.
- A change of recurring method applies from the next monthly bill.
- A payment settles the oldest unpaid bill first.

## Delinquency and termination

When a premium is unpaid on its due date, a delinquency letter is issued on the tier's delinquency-notice day after the due date.

The plan is terminated for nonpayment only once more than the grace days have passed since the due date of the oldest unpaid monthly premium. The grace period is the tier's nonpayment grace days.

- **Clock start:** the due date of the oldest unpaid monthly premium on the plan's premium ledger - the last calendar day of the month before that coverage month.
- **Counting:** the grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the due date, so termination may be processed from the day after the due date plus the grace days, and not on that day itself.
- **Boundary:** exclusive - the day that is the due date plus the grace days is still inside the grace period.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, grace of 30 days, June premium due 31 May and unpaid)

| Date | Termination for nonpayment |
|---|---|
| 30 June (31 May plus 30 days) | may not be processed |
| 1 July | may be processed |

## Effect of a nonpayment termination

Termination takes effect on the paid-through date: the last day of the latest coverage month whose initial-payment or monthly-premium bills are fully settled by payments referencing them. It starts a purchase lockout of the tier's lockout months, and it may be reviewed through an Enrollment Reinstatement Review filed within the tier's reinstatement-request window.

*Hypothetical:* bills for March, April and May are fully paid and the June bill is unpaid - the paid-through date is 31 May.
